notes.title: Ver. 1.2 Update: Added support for Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese
notes.content:
PARANORMASIGHT: The Seven Mysteries of Honjo has been updated to Ver. 1.2.
Details of the update are below.

Please note:
If you have saved partway through a chapter where the story is affected by the update, you will be forced to start again from the beginning of that chapter when loading your game after the update. Thank you for your understanding.


 Added support for Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese
 Added to staff credits

notes.title: Ver1.1 Update Content
notes.content:
“PARANORMASIGHT: The Seven Mysteries of Honjo” has been updated to Ver1.1.
Update details are as follows:

[Caution]
Please note that if an update has been made to a scenario where you saved in the middle of a chapter, you will need to start over from the beginning of that chapter when you load the game after the update.

■ Adjustments to Game Contents

・Implemented a “Fast-Forward Function” that will activate by holding the Cancel button. Players will be able to fast-forward all text and presentations freely with the exception of certain scenes.
(*Note) Due to the implementation of this function, we have made changes to the default controller layout. If you are using a custom controller layout, please be aware that you may not be able to use this fast-forwarding function.

・Added  feature in Video Options. If you wish to turn off chromatic aberration effects on-screen, you may do so by using this option.

・Adjustments have been made so that the cursor does not appear in unnecessary situations, such as during conversations.

・Adjustments to presentations and other contents have been made to a number of scenes where it may have been difficult to understand how to progress in the game.

・Adjustments have been made to various information messages so that they are easier to understand.

・When playing on a Steam Deck or in Big Picture mode, a software keyboard will be displayed when entering text.

・App icon has been changed.

■Fixed Issues

・Fixed the issue where the achievement “Don't Be a Quitter” could not be properly achieved. Those who meet the requirements can achieve this upon launching the game after updating to Ver1.1. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

・Fixed minor bugs
